adopt: Queue two runs at different priorities and watch the urgent one overtake.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
A shared runner pool serves whoever asked first, so an urgent one-line fix waits behind a queue of speculative work — and the only lever anyone has is asking people to stop pushing.

Install
pip install awrun
synopsis: A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it -- reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it.
